how: We read the website of every Tampa wedding planner listed on Lazo (134 listings, 93 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: beach ceremony package companies, an entertainment agency, venues and florists that also sell coordination, and a one-stop rentals network. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How many Tampa Bay venues have you worked this year, and what is the plan if a tropical storm hits the week of the wedding?
Full planning, partial, or day-of only? Ask what each tier includes in hours and in meetings.
Who is on site on the wedding day, the planner you hired or an associate?

picks.name: Special Moments Events Planning Inc
picks.blurb: Tammy left corporate America more than twenty years ago to plan weddings and holds the Master Wedding Planner designation, which the site notes only a select few carry. Special Moments in Largo plans weddings across Tampa, Clearwater, St. Petersburg and destination Florida, and books travel too.

picks.name: Events by Lindsay J.
picks.blurb: Lindsay Jimison runs a boutique luxury planning company in Tampa, with an editor's eye built on years of collaboration with the industry's creatives. Full service only: she works with you from the big-picture look and feel through execution.

picks.name: DA Event Planning
picks.blurb: A Tampa planner originally from Venezuela who specializes in full planning, wedding management and South Asian, multicultural and traditional weddings across Florida. The site lets you choose the level of guidance that meets you where you are.

picks.name: Eventrics Weddings
picks.blurb: Indian, South Asian and multicultural wedding planning from Lakeland, with each family's traditions, from a North Indian baraat to the Anand Karaj, learned and briefed to every partner vendor. Eventrics describes its work as scope and budget aligned, timelines disciplined, presence made possible.

picks.name: Planner Makes Perfect Weddings & Events
picks.blurb: Hundreds of weddings planned to date, with day-of, month-of, partial and full packages described as affordable and customizable to any budget. The Tampa company calls itself an LGBTQIA+ ally and advocate, and lists partial coordination starting at $2,000.

picks.name: Elegant Evening Events
picks.blurb: Cecilia and Maria pair twenty years of helping women dress for weddings and honeymoons with ten years of day-of coordination and planning, on the premise that every bride deserves her vision regardless of budget. Tampa-based, working Hillsborough, Pasco, Pinellas, Polk and Hernando counties.

picks.name: Breezin' Weddings
picks.blurb: Jessie and her team work behind the scenes on the wedding day so logistics run smoothly, and the site is built around couples' accounts of a planner who was first to arrive and last to leave. Tampa-based, handling everything from planning to execution.

picks.name: Red Rose Events
picks.blurb: Alexis Austin is a certified wedding planner and coordinator in Lakeland who turned planning her own wedding into a career. Red Rose Events ranges from all-inclusive, leave-everything-to-us planning down to as little help as you need.

picks.name: Elite Wedding Planning
picks.blurb: Rich Wiemer moved to the Tampa area from Long Island and started Elite Wedding Planning after a planner rescued his own wedding. Based in Odessa, offering customized vendor contracts, contract review and unlimited communication.

picks.name: The Venlist-Wedding Planner St. Pete
picks.blurb: A virtual wedding planner out of St. Petersburg for busy, budget-conscious couples: as much or as little support as you need, handled online instead of across twenty-six browser tabs. The Venlist calls itself one part planner, one part creative.

picks.name: Handled by Holly
picks.blurb: Holly came to wedding planning from ministry, as a former children's pastor with an eye for detail, and started by planning weddings for friends. Handled by Holly offers virtual and in-person planning and coordination in Tampa and beyond.

picks.name: Victorious Events
picks.blurb: Regine Simon is owner and lead planner of Victorious Events in Tampa, offering full and partial planning plus day-of coordination. A mother of three, she says faith guides her work and every completed event is a victory.
